geometry_edits.rationale: Slightly tighten the courtyard to keep the dominant solid stronger while preserving the public void and improving hierarchy.
Keep the public court opening aligned to the verified access side so the ground threshold remains legible.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact bar with a carved central void, and it responds positively to the neighborhood-living brief through an active ground threshold on the access side and a clear public court figure. It is visible in all four views and the void remains legible across plan and section, so it avoids the failure case of coherence in only one view. The dominant gesture is understandable, hierarchy is clear, and the mass is not merely filling a bounding box. The main weakness is that the roof/section remains somewhat generic and box-derived rather than strongly program-specific, so the section_program_fit is decent but not exceptional. Reference resonance is strongest with the courtyard/threshold precedents; the tower reference is only weakly transferable and the bridge reference is counterfactual.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Compact perimeter massing with a carved internal court that keeps the street edge legible while creating a sheltered public interior.
A calm outer envelope with a strongly articulated void sequence and planted threshold; good precedent for active ground/public interior.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More interior-room and enclosure driven than massing-led; limited direct geometric guidance.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Small-scale neighborhood hospitality logic: thickened wall/edge and intimate voids can translate to a mixed-use street building.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Tower typology is only loosely relevant to a compact neighborhood building; do not copy the vertical scale or tower language.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stacked upper mass over a more porous base suggests hierarchy and vertical differentiation.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Counterfactual typology; bridge-like long-span composition is not the right building type here and should only inform connective clarity.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Bridging/linear span implies continuity across an open condition.

warnings: The access response is adequate but still slightly sealed in elevation; a more explicit entry seam or undercut could improve public legibility.
Sectional expression could better signal mixed-use hierarchy and occupied roof/terrace logic.
The stepped internal subtraction is acceptable, but avoid letting it drift into arbitrary stair-like carving.
